purpose: Define the physical invariants that detect when a mutation is only locally true versus causally propagated, energy-disciplined, coupled, and verified across the organism.
invariants: A lifecycle mutation is not physically real until applied and verified layers have machine-readable evidence and read-back.
A canonical watch or event membrane promoted in one layer must propagate to downstream canonical consumers or remain explicitly transitional debt.
A shared runtime must not keep a poll-first default capability vocabulary after its canonical intake path has moved to wait/watch semantics.
Polling debt, fallback intervals, and legacy env wiring are energy leakage and must remain visible until removed.
A canonical execution path should converge toward a closed control loop with observation, dispatch, execution, read-back, and correction.
